prompt.text:
Implement pure animation calculations without timers or rendering APIs. Export `Bounds`, `MovingLabel`, `advanceLabel`, and `pulseScale`. `advanceLabel(label, bounds)` advances x by vx and y by vy once. A label occupies `width` by `height`. If the proposed position crosses an edge, reflect the corresponding velocity and place the label at the mirrored in-bounds position; support overshoots larger than one canvas span by repeated reflection. Exact contact with an edge does not reverse until movement would cross it. Bounds and label dimensions must be finite and positive; positions and velocities must be finite; malformed input throws `RangeError`. The returned label must be fresh and the input must not be mutated. `pulseScale(phase)` accepts any finite number and returns a triangular wave in the inclusive range 0.5 through 1, with values 0.5 at even integer phases and 1 at odd integer phases; negative phases wrap identically. Non-finite phases throw `RangeError`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
